name: Banh hoi My Phong
summary: Mỹ Phong’s own bánh hỏi, made in the noodle village alongside its hủ tiếu, bánh tét, bánh ít, and bánh tầm, and distinct from the Phong Điền kind.
howToEat: Look for it on a visit to the Mỹ Phong noodle village.
where: Ấp Hội Gia and ấp Mỹ Hòa in phường Mỹ Phong, and old phường 9, where the noodle yards open 07:00–18:00.
seoTitle: Banh hoi from the My Phong village
seoDescription: Bánh hỏi from the Mỹ Phong noodle village, made alongside its hủ tiếu, bánh tét, bánh ít, and bánh tầm.
